---
title: "Live 2026-27 season"
execute:
  freeze: false
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
for (f in c("R/figures.R")) source(f)
season <- 2027
log_path <- sprintf("live/predictions_%d.csv", season)
scored_path <- sprintf("live/scored_%d.csv", season)
log <- if (file.exists(log_path)) readr::read_csv(log_path, show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL
scored <- if (file.exists(scored_path)) readr::read_csv(scored_path, show_col_types = FALSE) else tibble::tibble()
updated <- if (!is.null(log)) max(log$predicted_at) else NA
```

Every morning a scheduled job updates the season's data, fits the frozen
models (trained on 2001-02 through 2025-26), and logs a home-win probability
for each of the day's games **before tip-off**. The log is append-only and is
committed by the scheduled job, so the repository's history and the job's run
logs record when each prediction was added. Once games are final, they are
scored here.

A team's first game of the season has no rolling history, so those games are
predicted with the Elo-only model for every model and marked as fallbacks.

**Backfilled games.** Logging started on October 28, 2026. Games played before
that were predicted afterwards and are labeled `backfill` in the log. They
were predicted the same way: features use only games before each game's date,
and the models never saw any 2026-27 data. A test checks that a backfilled
prediction equals the one made from data cut off before that day. They are
still not a pre-game record, so the tables show them separately.

Last prediction logged: `r updated` (UTC).

## Accuracy to date

```{r}
#| output: asis
acc_table <- function(d) {
  d |>
    group_by(model) |>
    summarise(
      Games = n(),
      acc = mean(correct),
      Brier = sprintf("%.3f", mean((prob_home - home_win)^2)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(acc)) |>
    transmute(Model = model, Games, Accuracy = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * acc), Brier) |>
    knitr::kable(align = "lrrr")
}
if (nrow(scored) == 0) {
  cat("No logged games have finished yet.\n")
} else {
  n_games <- length(unique(scored$game_id))
  n_pre <- length(unique(scored$game_id[scored$source == "pre-game"]))
  cat(sprintf(
    paste(
      "%d games scored: %d backfilled, %d logged before tip-off.",
      "With this few games, accuracy can move by about %.0f percentage points either way.\n\n"
    ),
    n_games, n_games - n_pre, n_pre, 100 * 1.96 * sqrt(0.25 / n_games)
  ))
}
```

```{r}
if (nrow(scored) > 0) acc_table(scored)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4
if (nrow(scored) > 0 && length(unique(scored$game_date)) > 1) {
  pre <- scored$game_date[scored$source == "pre-game"]
  plot_live_accuracy(
    scored,
    c("Logistic: Elo only", "Ridge: rolling + Elo", "Majority (home win rate)"),
    pregame_start = if (length(pre)) min(pre) else NULL
  )
}
```

### Pre-game predictions only

```{r}
#| output: asis
pre_scored <- if (nrow(scored) > 0) filter(scored, source == "pre-game") else scored
if (nrow(pre_scored) == 0) cat("No games logged before tip-off have finished yet.\n") else acc_table(pre_scored)
```

## Latest predictions

```{r}
if (!is.null(log)) {
  latest <- max(log$game_date)
  log |>
    filter(game_date == latest, model %in% c("Ridge: rolling + Elo", "Logistic: Elo only")) |>
    select(home, away, model, prob_home, fallback) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = prob_home) |>
    transmute(
      Game = paste(away, "at", home),
      `Ridge + Elo: P(home win)` = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * `Ridge: rolling + Elo`),
      `Elo only` = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * `Logistic: Elo only`),
      Pick = ifelse(`Ridge: rolling + Elo` >= 0.5, home, away),
      Fallback = ifelse(fallback, "yes", "")
    ) |>
    knitr::kable(caption = paste("Games on", latest), align = "lrrrc")
}
```

The full log, with every model's probability, is
[`live/predictions_2027.csv`](https://github.com/kalebcoleman/nba-modeling/blob/main/live/predictions_2027.csv).
